components.description: The highest-performance King Goat yet. The 62.5Ah version features an advanced SVolt EV battery, increased power output, and our latest V3 upgrades.; Up to 12,500W peak power; Nearly 400 Nm of torque; Approximately 30% more peak power than the 40Ah version; 72V 62.5Ah SVolt EV battery; Kinetic Energy Recovery; Puncture-resistant, self-healing vacuum-sealed tires; Upgraded controller and gear ratio

Add the optional 72V 20Ah gas tank-style battery to create a massive 82.5Ah dual-battery system, delivering nearly 6 kWh of total battery capacity.; Combined with up to 12,500W of peak power, this gives the King Goat V3 one of the most capable power and battery combinations available on a production high-performance e-bike today.; With the full 82.5Ah setup, the King Goat can achieve 200+ miles on a single charge depending on riding conditions and usage.

The 40Ah King Goat V3 delivers the same proven platform with serious performance and everyday range.; Up to 8,500W peak power; Up to 320 Nm of torque; Speeds exceeding 65 MPH under appropriate riding conditions; 72V 40Ah integrated battery; Regenerative braking; Upgraded controller and gear ratio

Both versions include our latest upgraded controller and revised gear ratio for smoother power delivery, stronger acceleration, improved responsiveness, and a more refined ride.; The King Goat V3 also features inverted front forks, DOT-4 Karasawa hydraulic brakes, and upgraded rear suspension for improved traction and control.; Actual speed, power, torque, and range vary based on rider weight, terrain, battery charge, riding style, and operating conditions.

Choose the riding experience that best fits your environment and riding style:; ECO – Smooth, efficient power delivery; NORMAL – Balanced performance for everyday riding; MAX TORQUE – Maximum low-end acceleration; SPORT – Optimized for high-performance riding
Bike Box: 62 × 13 × 33 in. — 190 lbs; Battery Box: 21 × 18 × 10 in. — 75 lbs
The All-Black model comes with the grey seat logo, and the Gold Forks model comes with the Original Gradient orange seat logo.

This product may not qualify as an electric bicycle ("e-bike") under the laws of every jurisdiction. Vehicle classifications, licensing, registration, insurance requirements, and permitted operating locations vary by location.

The King Goat V3 ships from the factory configured with a 20 MPH speed limit. Additional operating modes may be available as described in the owner's manual. Owners and operators are responsible for complying with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.; Learn more by visiting our Vehicle Classification & Legal Information page.
